name: Casper Locke
source:
Class: Wizard

An extroverted, playful, and flirty theater student, Casper is Julian's roommate. He has big dreams of making it to Broadway someday.

Julian introduces Casper to Lost Heroes, but as they play together and bond, a string of secrets starts to unravel...

[From [url=https://gallium-games.itch.io/guilded-hearts]official page[/url]]

His in-game nickname is Moogie.

[spoiler]Eventually starts dating Verdant unless his route was chosen.[/spoiler]
